_comment: Demo steps. title = big line on screen, description = how to do it. Both are read aloud as: 'Step N of M. <title>. <description>'. Edit freely; restart the server to re-generate the audio.
title: Isolate CB-12 on PDU B2-07

steps.title: Go to Row B, Rack 2
steps.description: Walk to hall 1, row B, rack 2. Your target is PDU B2-07, the power strip on the left side of the rack, on feed A. Don't touch anything yet.

steps.title: Scan the QR on PDU B2-07
steps.description: Use the phone to scan the QR tag on the left PDU. The right PDU, B2-08, looks the same but is the wrong one.

steps.title: Confirm feed B is healthy
steps.description: Hold point. When CB-12 opens, feed B on PDU B2-08 carries the whole rack. Its load must be under 50 percent before you go on.

steps.title: Open breaker CB-12
steps.description: Switch breaker CB-12 on PDU B2-07 to off. Wait until the current reads zero amps.

steps.title: Tag CB-12 and log complete
steps.description: Hang a lockout tag on CB-12 so nobody switches it back on, then log the job as complete.
